text: dsh-find-plugin 是一个 DSH Web 插件发现工具，可在会话中搜索 DSH 插件。它注册 find_dsh_plugin 工具，同时查询 GitHub 的 dsh-plugin topic 与精选 awesome-dsh-plugin 列表，将结果去重、按需补齐，并输出描述和可执行的安装命令；GitHub 搜索不可用时可退回精选列表。适合想按功能寻找 DSH 插件并快速获得安装命令的用户。可选配置 DSH 凭据 GITHUB_TOKEN。

dsh-find-plugin helps DSH Web users discover plugins. Its find_dsh_plugin tool searches GitHub’s dsh-plugin topic and the curated awesome-dsh-plugin list, returning descriptions and install commands. It can fall back to the curated list. GITHUB_TOKEN is optional.
想按功能搜索 DSH 插件并拿到安装命令
帮我在会话里找能实现某个需求的 DSH 扩展
Find DSH plugins by capability and show me how to install them.
dsh-find-plugin 的功能「按需求发现插件」：调用 find_dsh_plugin 并提供关键词，可限制结果数量及偏好描述语言；工具联合搜索 GitHub 插件主题和精选列表，合并结果后返回名称、说明、来源、链接与安装命令。
dsh-find-plugin 使用前须知：搜索关键词会发送到 GitHub 搜索 API；可选 GITHUB_TOKEN 凭据随请求用于认证。
dsh-find-plugin 使用前须知：会从 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 获取 registry，并在 DSH_HOME 下缓存 registry.json。
dsh-find-plugin 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 62 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

> [`awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin)
> 0.3.7 的维护分支。改动与实测证据见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-find-plugin README · Why this fork / 为什么有这个分支：Upstream calls the GitHub **search** API anonymously. That endpoint allows only
**10 requests/minute per public IP**, and the quota is shared by everyone behind
the same egress IP — so the tool fails with a bare `GitHub search HTTP 403` all
the time (measured: 13 rapid calls → 7×403 / 6×200; even a session's *first*
call can 403). Upstream's only mitigation is a 5-minute per-query cache, and the
~3400-entry curated list is used **only after** a successful search, so it can
never act as a fallback.
section: Why this fork / 为什么有这个分支

dsh-find-plugin README · Why this fork / 为什么有这个分支：上游匿名调用 GitHub **搜索**接口，而该接口只有 **10 次/分钟/公网 IP** 的额度、且按出口 IP
共享 —— 于是 `find_dsh_plugin` 经常直接以 403 失败（实测 13 次连发 7 次 403；一次会话的
**首次**调用就可能 403）。上游的防护只有 5 分钟按 query 缓存，而 curated 列表只在搜索
**成功之后**才被使用，起不到兜底作用。

This fork adds token auth, dual-source merge, a persistent + conditional
registry cache, and a real degradation chain.

本分支补上：token 鉴权、双源合并、registry 磁盘缓存 + 条件请求、以及真正的降级链。
section: Why this fork / 为什么有这个分支

text:
dsh-find-plugin README · What's different / 与上游的差异：| | upstream 0.3.7 | this fork 0.4.0 |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub auth | anonymous (10 req/min/IP) | `GITHUB_TOKEN` credential → 30 req/min, not IP-shared |
| 403 / 429 | throw | retry once, then a typed rate-limit error carrying `limit`/`remaining`/`resetAt` |
| network error | throw | retry once |
| failure caching | none | 60s (a retry loop can't keep burning quota) |
| curated list | description enrichment only, after a successful search | merged as a real second source; also the fallback |
| registry fetch | 2.7MB every hour, memory only | disk cache + `If-None-Match`/`If-Modified-Since` (304 = zero body) |
| offline fallback | bundled snapshot (~176 entries, stale) | memory → disk cache (~3400) → bundled snapshot |
| result labelling | — | per-item `source`, `[curated]` marker in rendered text |
| `exec.signal` | declared `timeoutMs`, signal ignored | forwarded; `timeoutMs` 25s |
| tests | none shipped | 33 offline cases + opt-in live cases + `tsc --noEmit` |
section: What's different / 与上游的差异

dsh-find-plugin README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:vclike/dsh-find-plugin
```

Then restart `dsh web` (bundle layers are composed at boot).

dsh-find-plugin README · Configure a GitHub token (recommended)：Without a token the tool still works, but it is capped at 10 requests/minute per
public IP and degrades to the curated list whenever that is exhausted. With a
token you get 30 requests/minute and no shared-IP interference.

dsh-find-plugin README · Configure a GitHub token (recommended)：The token is read from the DSH credential named **`GITHUB_TOKEN`** (via
`ctx.credentials.resolve('GITHUB_TOKEN')`) — the same credential
`dsh-github-companion` uses, usually backed by the `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment
variable of the DSH process. The plugin stays **zero-dependency**: it never
imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials`, it only resolves that reference through
the credentials service when one exists.

dsh-find-plugin README · Configure a GitHub token (recommended)：未配置 token 时也能用，但受 10 次/分钟/公网 IP 限制，额度耗尽即降级到 curated 列表；
配置后为 30 次/分钟且不受共享出口 IP 影响。凭据名是 **`GITHUB_TOKEN`**（与
`dsh-github-companion` 同一份）。

dsh-find-plugin README · Output：```
1. dsh-mnemon ★143 — 跨会话记忆 / cross-session memory
   https://github.com/owner/dsh-mnemon
   install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/dsh-mnemon

Ranking: GitHub results first (star-ranked, as upstream), then curated-only
matches fill the remaining `limit` slots. When GitHub is unavailable the note
states why, and the results are curated keyword matches only.

排序：GitHub 结果在前（按 stars，与上游一致），curated-only 条目补足剩余名额。
GitHub 不可用时 note 说明原因，结果为 curated 关键词匹配（并标注）。

dsh-find-plugin README · Tool parameters：| param | meaning |
|---|---|
| `query` (required) | keywords, e.g. `"wechat notifications"`, `"TUI"`, `"跨会话记忆"` |
| `limit` | max results, default 8, capped at 20 |
| `lang` | preferred description language (`en` / `zh`), default `en` |

dsh-find-plugin README · Development：```bash
node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"               # 33 offline cases (mock fetch), ~8s
FINDP_LIVE=1 node --test test/live.test.mjs    # 3 cases against the real network
npm run typecheck                              # tsc --noEmit over src/*.ts (TS 5.9.3)
```

dsh-find-plugin README · Development：`lib/**/*.js` is the **runtime artifact and source of truth**; `src/**/*.ts` is the
typed mirror, validated by `typecheck` but never compiled over `lib/` — upstream's
`prepack` would silently revert fixes applied to `lib/`, so that script is removed
here.

`lib/` 是运行时产物与唯一真源；`src/*.ts` 是类型镜像，由 `typecheck` 校验但**不会**编译
覆盖 `lib/`（上游的 `prepack` 会静默还原对 `lib/` 的修复，本分支已移除该脚本）。

Layout / 目录：

dsh-find-plugin README · Development：```
lib/index.js                    tool registration, dual-source merge, rendering
lib/github.js                   GitHub search: token, retry, typed rate-limit error, caches
lib/registry.js                 curated registry: disk cache, conditional request, fallbacks
data/registry-snapshot.json     last-resort bundled snapshot
